source: Ichigo Shikano in-game Skills screen (Talent and Awareness tabs), user screenshots 2026-09-06

talents.Overflowing Love: For each Chains of Love stack, increase Ichigo's Attack by 15.0%.
talents.Melting Ichi-Go Butter: When Ichigo is present, increase party's continuous damage by 15.0%.
talents.Mine Alone: The first time Ichigo activates Vorpal Butterfly, gain 1 Chains of Love stack. Also, each time she activates a Highlight, gain 1 Chains of Love stack. Chains of Love stacks up to 3 times. Gain the following effects based on the number of Chains of Love stacks. 1: For each Lovesick stack inflicted, increase target's damage taken by 4%. 2: Increase critical rate by 15%. Also, all of Ichigo's skill damage is counted as continuous damage. 3: Increase continuous damage by 25%.
talents.Pounding Heartbeat: For each Lovesick stack inflicted, decrease target's Defense by 3%. Also, each time a skill is used, inflict 1 more Lovesick stack on the target.
talents.Power of Love: At the start of battle, gain 1 Chains of Love stack. Chains of Love now stacks up to 5 times, and gain the following effects based on the number of stacks. 4: Increase critical damage by 36%. 5: The first time Ichigo takes fatal damage, survive with 1 HP and enter a special near-death state, and gain 4 Power of Love stacks. At the end each ally's turn, spend 1 Power of Love stack, and after all Power of Love stacks have been spent, Ichigo will be KO'd.
talents.Forever My Prince: Increase the skill levels of My Beloved Prince and Thief Tactics by 3.
talents.Maiden's True Strength: Highlight Enhanced: Each time her Highlight is activated, permanently increase Ichigo's Attack by 6%. Stacks up to 5 times.
talents.Garden of Devotion: Increase the skill levels of Vorpal Butterfly and Obsessive Rose by 3.
talents.A World of Our Own: Lovesick now stacks up to 15 times. Based on the total number of Chains of Love stacks, the following effects can be activated. 1: After activating Vorpal Butterfly, activate Vorpal Butterfly 1 more time on the selected target. 2: After activating Obsessive Rose, activate Obsessive Rose 1 more time on the selected target. 3: After activating My Beloved Prince, activate My Beloved Prince 1 more time on the selected target. 4: During Ichigo's turn, can activate Highlight 1 time on the selected target without spending the Highlight gauge (not affected by Highlight cooldown time). (Each effect can activate only once during battle. If a target is defeated or the skill is nullified, reflected, or absorbed, a different target is selected for the skill effect.)

implication: Mine Alone Chain 2 literally counts all of Ichigo's skill damage as continuous damage, which is the engine's existing Chain 2 conversion. The flat +15% reading is ruled out.
